inspector.noDocument: Open a scene to inspect what is in it.

inspector.alignCamera: Put this camera where the view is looking
inspector.alignCameraHint: Gives the camera the place and the direction of the current view
inspector.addRail: Create a path for this camera

inspector.addPathPoint: Add a point to the path

inspector.name: Name
inspector.resetHint: Puts this property back where it stood before anything changed it
inspector.stackFoldHint: Put the axes back on one line

inspector.linkAxesHint: Moving one axis takes the others with it, in the ratio they held when it was locked
inspector.rotationInert: A sprite always faces the camera: turning it shows only where it carries children
inspector.browseTextureHint: Choose from every image in the project, local and remote alike
inspector.noModelTexture: No image was taken out of this model.
inspector.openTextureHint: Double-click to open this image in the Textures space
inspector.openMaterialHint: Double-click to open this material in the Textures space
inspector.unclaimedChannel: This image does not fit a single channel
inspector.empty: Select something to see its properties.
inspector.roleGuessed: Guessed from the extension. To correct it, this file has to be an asset of the project
inspector.pinHint: Keep it on the home screen, in every project
inspector.pinFull: The home screen holds {{max}} recipes at most — unpin one to pin this one
inspector.regenerateHint: Open the generator with these parameters
inspector.openSkyHint: Double-click to open this sky in its own space
inspector.noFontOffered: No font this machine can read
inspector.title: Title
inspector.expressionHint: Write CEL: a wire reads as the id of the node it comes from, then _output
inspector.rigNotHumanoid: The studio only lays a humanoid skeleton — hips, spine, two arms and two legs.
inspector.rigReady: This model has been given a skeleton.
inspector.animationLibraryEmpty: No animation in this project yet.
inspector.animationImportHint: Accepted formats: {{formats}}. The file stays where it is.
inspector.animationAiNone: No motion service in the catalogue.
inspector.animationFits: The character can play this motion.
inspector.animationFitsPartly: The animation is not a perfect fit.
inspector.rigServicesLocked: Scenario services can do this too; the {{plan}} subscription does not allow them. The studio does it itself, for free.

inspector.rigFault_noGeometry: This model is too flat to take a skeleton.
inspector.rigFault_lyingDown: This model is lying down. Stand it up before making it animatable.
inspector.rigStatus_staticMesh: This model cannot be animated yet.
inspector.rigStatus_skinnedMesh: This model has a skeleton with no recognised joints.
inspector.rigStatus_riggedCharacter: This character is ready to animate.
inspector.rigStatus_skeletonOnly: This file holds a skeleton only, with no character to animate.
inspector.revealHint: Opens the file manager on the selected asset
inspector.addBranch: Add a branch, with its output
inspector.removeBranch: Remove this branch and its output
inspector.addCondition: Add a condition to this branch
inspector.combine: How this combines with the condition above
inspector.noFontHint: No font picked; the text keeps the document’s own
inspector.lock_pixelsHint: Stops paint from landing on this layer, without pinning it in place
inspector.lock_positionHint: Stops the layer from being moved; it can still be painted on
inspector.lock_alphaHint: Paints only where the layer already has something
inspector.addList: Add a list to iterate over, with the port giving its item
